data.name: Aamena
data.gender_notes: Aamena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aamena is derived from the Arabic root 'A'imana, which means 'to trust'. It is a name given to girls, signifying trustworthiness and reliability. In Islamic tradition, Aamena is the name of a virtuous woman mentioned in the Hadith, who was known for her unwavering faith and trust in Allah. The name Aamena carries the meaning “Trustworthy, Dependable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aamena usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, dependable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing faith and trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Aamena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, Dependable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamena total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
